articles.title: Does ChatGPT Measure Up to Doctors When It Comes to Questions About IVF?
articles.excerpt: (MedPage Today) -- BALTIMORE -- ChatGPT's answers to patient queries about assisted reproductive technology (ART) were generally accurate but less complete than professional society education materials, a comparative analysis showed. On a scale...
articles.summary: 一项比较分析显示，ChatGPT对辅助生殖技术（ART）患者提问的回答总体准确，但完整性不及专业学会教育材料。
